SGTM. Quick tech notes so the regenerated invite doesn't trip Greenleaf's SSO:

- The original ICS included both a google-meet:// and a zoom:// uri and some vendors' calendar parsers pick the first token they see (ours apparently ended up as the Meet link). Regenerate with only the Zoom join URL in the LOCATION and DESCRIPTION fields.
- Use our staging@redwoodinference.com service account as the organizer for the new ICS (that avoids org-homed tokens).
- For safety, include a plain-text backup Zoom URL at the top of the event body and a short instruction: "If you get an SSO block on the inlined link, click the backup Zoom link below."
- Marissa: please include "Allow participants to join before host" and a quick dial-in numeric moderator code so Greenleaf folks can get in even if the host joins late.

Ops attachment: ops-checklist.txt (I ran through host claim/test steps locally).

Ben
